description: ESM-MSR's Megascale (Tsuboyama 2023 Dataset 2+3) preprocessing reproduced from the released archive, with the released hyperopt_splits protein partition (train / val / internal test by code_wt; engineered backgrounds inherit their parent's partition).

labels.canonical: score = raw ddG_ML kcal/mol, WT-relative, positive = stabilizing; duplicates averaged; no WT rows

test.policy: released internal test; read only after configurations are frozen (--final-test)

eval_panels.test_internal: esm_msr_hyperopt split == 'test' (reconciles with the paper's 43,700 / 32,968 / 10,732 counts)
eval_panels.external_not_imported: ptmuld, s461, ssym (upstream validation metric) are not imported

metrics.selection: validation only (development experiments use the experiment's declared --selection rule)
metrics.upstream: per-protein Spearman grouped by code_wt over singles+doubles pooled, safe_spearman min_n=2, nDCG@96 (compute_ndcg_flexible) and ndcg_t0; mirrored in mutant_cache/eval/megascale.py but not yet verified to reproduce upstream reported numbers

notes: status=ready covers training on the released development partition only.

A matched external comparison is UNRESOLVED: paper checkpoint provenance (HuggingFace checkpoints not downloaded; bundled esm-msr-small is not the paper model), row mapping (upstream drops mismatching constituents; target_id vs code_wt grouping), metric reproduction, and training-overlap audit of their checkpoint are all open.
mutant_cache.matched_suite is specialized to Mutate Everything and must not be used as an ESM-MSR evaluator.
Not reproduced: upstream reversion/mut_ctx augmentation, 2-D double rebalancing in their sampler.
